title: Part 6 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 6 Determination of Modulus of Rupture and Breaking Strength ( Second Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 6) covers a method of test for determining the modulus of rupture and breaking strength of all ceramic tiles.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Methods of Test for Vulcanized Rubber, Part 2: Rubber, Vulcanized or Thermoplastic - Determination of Hardness (Hardness Between 10 IRHD and 100 IRHD)

clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 6 Determination of Modulus of Rupture and Breaking Strength

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
